> **Remove personal data before posting.** This page is public. Don't paste your resume, emails, contact names, phone numbers, addresses, health details or anything from your `profile/`, `jobs/`, `contacts/` or `outbox/` folders. You don't need to tell us about a disability or diagnosis: describe what got in the way, not why.

Thank you for telling us. Short answers are fine, and you can leave out any question.
